title: Imaging of the lumbar spine

criteria.text: Low back pain with pain in the leg for at least 6 weeks.
Conservative therapy for at least 6 weeks is tried and documented, for example physical therapy or medication.
A nerve deficit or a warning sign is documented, for example weakness, numbness or loss of bladder control.
Plain X-rays of the spine, if any, are listed.

documentation: The dates of the conservative therapy.
The findings of the last examination.
